clients.label: Ashburn, Virginia
clients.note: A Railway server in Ashburn, Virginia: the same metro as most of the buckets, like an app on AWS us-east-1. Railway Buckets is on the same network here, which helps it. S3 is in Ohio, about 10 ms farther away.

clients.label: Florida home line
clients.note: A home server in Florida on an AT&T line. This is the closest thing to a user's machine. The line's upload speed limits the 100 MB uploads, so those numbers say more about the line than the providers.

clients.label: San Francisco
clients.note: A Freestyle VM in San Francisco. Every bucket is across the country.

clients.label: Seattle
clients.note: A Tenki VM in Seattle. Every bucket is across the country.

clients.label: Amsterdam
clients.note: A Railway server in Amsterdam. Every bucket is across the Atlantic. Railway Buckets is on the same network here.

clients.label: Lille, France
clients.note: A boat sandbox on OVH in Lille, France. Every bucket is across the Atlantic.

rows.label: Amazon S3
rows.model: $0.023/GB-month, $0.005 per 1k writes, $0.0004 per 1k reads, egress $0.09/GB after 100 GB/month free (then $0.085, $0.07 tiers)
rows.source: https://aws.amazon.com/s3/pricing/ (storage, requests, and data transfer tabs, US East (Ohio)); same values in the AWS Price List API, AmazonS3 and AWSDataTransfer offers

rows.label: Cloudflare R2
rows.model: $0.015/GB-month after 10 GB free, $4.50 per 1M writes after 1M, $0.36 per 1M reads after 10M, egress free

rows.label: Railway Buckets
rows.model: $0.015/GB-month, requests and egress free. The Free plan covers up to 10 GB-month with its $1 monthly credit; Hobby ($5/month, counted toward usage) caps storage at 1 TB; Pro ($20/month, counted toward usage) has no cap

rows.label: Backblaze B2
rows.model: $6.95/TB-month after 10 GB free, class A/B/C requests free, egress free up to 3x stored then $0.01/GB

rows.label: Neon
rows.model: $0.023/GB-month, requests free, 500 GB/month egress per project then $0.10/GB (shared with Postgres traffic)

rows.label: Supabase Storage
rows.model: $25/month Pro plan (its $10 compute credit covers the Micro instance), 100 GB stored then $0.0213/GB-month, 250 GB uncached egress then $0.09/GB, no per-request charges listed. Egress is priced at the uncached rate; egress served from the Smart CDN cache is $0.03/GB
